gaps.explanation: Every governmental fund is in detail[] (General Fund, Veterans Aid subfund, Highway, Federal Grants and the 14 nonmajor funds), but from the Budget and Actual - Budgetary Basis schedules (pp9-11, 15-30) while the statement (p5) is GAAP; the printed budgetary totals add exactly to the schedule total 203,092,341. GAAP (p5, pp12-14) minus budgetary: General 131,090,317 - 130,710,322 (p9) = 379,995; Highway 12,296,222 - 10,994,281 (p28) = 1,301,941; Federal Grants 14,230,499 - 39,210,186 (p11) = -24,979,687 (p11 'Revenue accruals' (24,979,688)); nonmajor 21,666,679 (p14) - 22,177,552 (sum of the 14 nonmajor schedule totals) = -510,873, which includes the Mental Health Fund budget schedule's revenue 'County aid' 1,013,160 (p20) that the GAAP combining statement prints as Mental Health Transfers in 1,013,160 (p13), and budget-vs-GAAP differences such as Sinking Fund 203,134 vs 218,878. 379,995 + 1,301,941 - 24,979,687 - 510,873 = -23,808,624 = gap (statement 179,283,717). No fix (the 1,013,160 stays a revenue as printed on the budget schedule).

Budgetary schedule totals add to 165,420,594. Against the GAAP columns (p5): General 112,524,975 (p10) + Veterans Aid 11,048 (p30) = 112,536,023 vs Total General 112,152,469 (p12): 383,554 above; Federal Grants 8,037,509 (p11) vs 10,971,902: 2,934,393 short (p11 expenditure accruals (3,262,706), encumbrances 478,506 on the budgetary side); Highway 17,644,850 (p28) vs 21,721,699: 4,076,849 short; 14 nonmajor schedules 27,202,212 vs nonmajor column 24,484,470 (p14): 2,717,742 above (e.g. Bridge and Special Road 9,124,434 vs 6,196,114). 383,554 - 2,934,393 - 4,076,849 + 2,717,742 = -3,909,946 = gap (statement 169,330,540). No fix.

Statement transfers in 21,998,965 (p5) = General 1,509,981 + Highway 7,783,916 + nonmajor 12,705,068 (p14). Detail transfers in 20,985,805 (General 1,509,981, Highway 7,783,916, Weed Control 188,321, Building 11,966, County Property Management 11,532, Bridge and Special Road 6,146,484, Sinking 5,333,605). The missing 1,013,160 is the Mental Health Fund's transfer in on the GAAP combining statement (p13), which the Mental Health budget schedule (p20) prints as the revenue line 'County aid' 1,013,160 and which is in detail as revenue (explained under revenue). Kept as printed. No fix.
